newsitem.title: UK: Bank Handlowy Eurobond expected on Wednesday-JPM.
newsitem.headline: Bank Handlowy Eurobond expected on Wednesday-JPM.

text.p: Poland's Bank Handlowy is expected to issue a dollar Eurobond on Wednesday, an official at lead manager J.P. Morgan said on Tuesday.
"Bank Handlowy will probably launch its bond on Wednesday," the official said, adding Bank Handlowy had opted for a three-year maturity.
The deal's size is expected to be around $150 million, and Bank Handlowy officials had previously said the issue would have a three- or five-year maturity.
Bank Handlowy first came to the Eurobond market in 1996, when it launched a $100 million three-year bond at 88 basis points over U.S. Treasury notes.
This deal was now trading at 55-50 b.p. over Treasuries, dealers said, and Wednesday's issue was expected to be priced to yield slightly over this level.
Handlowy, which is earmarked for with around 30 percent of shares set aside for sale in June, has a Baa3 investment grade rating from Moody's Investors Service.
Officials from the bank held roadshows last week in preparation for this week's bond issue.
